items.title: Lawrence Trotter Interview, 1966-01-13
items.q: I think his father played drums.

ctx.x: And what about Adam's father? Did he play? Can you tell me a question?
I think his father played drums. I don't remember him, but I think his father played. You didn't know him. I didn't know him. Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm.
Can you think about anything actually about those early days? Okay. I don't worry about it. When did you stop playing? I stopped playing in 46. Mm-hmm.
